6ee325ef-fa88-4676-bee6-568cfe59dd1b:
query TravelerDashboard($userId: ID!) {
    travelerDashboard(userId: $userId) {
      userId
      headline
      moodLine
      tripCount
      averageChaos
      hops
      nextTrip {
        id
        title
        destination
        chaosScore
        chaosBand
        daysUntil
        packingProgress
      }
      trips {
        id
        userId
        title
        destination
        destinationKey
        startDate
        endDate
        status
        vibe
        notes
        chaosScore
        chaosBand
        stampEarned
        packingProgress
        daysUntil
        packingList { id label packed absurdity }
        itinerary { day title detail }
        createdAt
        updatedAt
      }
      featuredStory {
        id
        title
        topics
        vibeIndex
      }
    }
  }

# Variables
{
  "userId": "u-wanderer"
}
